method: Sum existing served-mode free-running wall per each exact onset seed (36 x 3); for each of 36 cap-extension case/seed pairs, retain observed prefill/host overhead and scale its measured decode wall by (cap-1)/observed_decode_tokens; add measured served candidate-family load. Apply 0.7x–1.5x uncertainty to generation wall for unmeasured HiFi2 effects; keep the observed load fixed. No teacher-forcing time because branches=[] in proposed manifest.
interpretation: Diagnostic serial traced runtime estimate, not serving performance, device time, a score projection, or a measured candidate outcome.
